scope: Reconcile exact AC1009 output, requested-version promotion, and semantic downgrade behavior across open-source writer claims, Autodesk SAVEAS policy, and the local DXF writer; refine only existing versioned output and peer-comparison gates.

method.kind: Primary-source documentation/source review and read-only local implementation/test audit
localInspection: src/libdxfrw.cpp: target-version selection, header emission, AC1009 structural gates, and writer refusal paths
src/intern/dxfwriter.cpp: R12 versus R13+ binary group-code implementations
tests/dxf_fixture_tests.cpp: generated R12 ASCII/binary writer, identity, sequence, downgrade, and refusal controls
DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: existing PAR-02, PAR-09, PAR-80, R12 owner and peer-artifact provenance entries
method.limitations: The ACadRust source URL and cad2d-ir README are mutable and were not bound to an installed package artifact or executed. Autodesk's R12 SAVEAS page was available in a localized rendering marked automatically translated. Capability statements and source code do not establish native acceptance or comprehensive R12 semantics.

evidence.observed: The Autodesk Support article says R12 DXF retains only the last active layout as paper space, removes unsupported objects/features including proxy objects, and can suppress dimensions or change appearance/properties.
doesNotEstablish: a complete normative R12 DXF grammar
that third-party writers should silently apply the same omissions
that a parseable R12 file preserves all source semantics
evidence.planUse: Track per-record mapping, explicit omission/refusal, diagnostic, and publication outcome independently from R12 parseability.

evidence.topic: ACadRust requested versus effective DXF output version
evidence.observed: The public matrix advertises AC1009 read/write, while the current SectionWriter source normalizes a requested AC1009 target to AC1012 because its output path emits R13+ handles, owners, subclass markers, and OBJECTS structure; its header uses the normalized version.
doesNotEstablish: a requirement that libdxfrw upgrade an R12 request
runtime behavior of a pinned ACadRust release
that every AC1009 read/write matrix cell means exact AC1009 output
evidence.planUse: Capture requested version and actual emitted $ACADVER/structural profile independently; score R12-source-to-R13-output as version promotion, not R12 output.

evidence.observed: The project README describes AC1009 output with feature-specific conversions and ExportDiagnostic entries for skipped, approximated, exploded, or normalized content, and lists R12 semantic limitations for true color, lineweight, and INSUNITS.
doesNotEstablish: behavior of a particular published wheel or sdist
independent runtime or native CAD acceptance
raw-record identity preservation for derived geometry
evidence.planUse: Consider only as a provenance-qualified optional downgrade comparator; compare to a source-authored expected mapping, not peer-generated expected bytes.

evidence.topic: Local AC1009 writer and existing test coverage
evidence.observed: The local writer selects R12 binary group-code framing for AC1009, emits the requested revision in the header, gates handles/owners/subclasses, and has generated R12 ASCII/binary controls for several entity, carrier, downgrade, and refusal paths.
doesNotEstablish: that every unsupported field or object family is diagnosed
native CAD acceptance on any platform
evidence.planUse: Reuse current focused test owners; bind the effective emitted version and per-source-record outcome at the composed versioned-output checkpoint.

refinedOwners: PAR-02 versioned DXF write and independent acceptance matrix
PAR-80 and existing R12 derived-entity/downgrade owners
readinessRefinement: record source version, requested target, actual emitted $ACADVER, and structural version profile separately
distinguish exact R12 output from a modern-version promotion of an R12 source
for intentional R12 lowering, bind source identity to exact or derived output, diagnostics, refusal/omission, and strict reopen
defer mutable peer runtime comparison until exact artifact/source correspondence is resolved
